title: Short sleep and next-day psoriasis flares
abstract: Adults with psoriasis who slept under six hours had a higher flare score the next day. Short sleep lined up with itch and new plaque, separate from the cream they put on after the flare started.

title: A diary of sleep duration and psoriasis
abstract: In a twelve week diary, sleep under six hours preceded next-day psoriasis flares. Stress was written down on its own line and did not erase the sleep signal.

title: Metformin and insulin sensitivity
abstract: Metformin improved insulin sensitivity in adults with high fasting glucose. The metformin arm was followed for six months.

title: Fasting glucose on metformin
abstract: Fasting glucose fell on metformin. Insulin sensitivity rose in that arm and did not rise on placebo.

title: BRCA1 and contralateral breast cancer
abstract: Women with a BRCA1 mutation had a higher contralateral breast cancer risk after the first diagnosis than women without the mutation.

title: Contralateral breast events in BRCA1 carriers
abstract: Contralateral breast events were more common in BRCA1 carriers. The gap remained after age at the first breast diagnosis was taken into account.

title: Systolic blood pressure and later stroke
abstract: Higher systolic blood pressure raised the chance of a later stroke in middle-aged adults. The rise was steady across the upper half of the pressure range.

title: Which pressure number tracks stroke
abstract: Stroke risk climbed with systolic blood pressure. Diastolic pressure added little once systolic blood pressure was already in the model.

title: An SSRI in major depression
abstract: An SSRI reduced clinician-rated scores in major depression over eight weeks compared with placebo. Sleepiness was recorded and was not the endpoint.

title: Major depression scores on an SSRI
abstract: Major depression scores fell further on the SSRI than on placebo. Nausea was more common on the drug.
